50:2.text: But they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves, and the disbelievers say, "This is an amazing thing.

50:3.text: When we have died and have become dust,

50:4.text: We know what the earth diminishes
of them, and with Us is a retaining record.

50:5.text: But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition.

50:6.text: Have they not looked at the heaven above them - how We structured it and adorned it and

50:7.text: And the earth - We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein

50:8.text: Giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns

50:9.text: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest

50:10.text: And lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers -

50:11.text: As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land. Thus is the emergence

50:12.text: The people of Noah denied before them,
and the companions of the well

50:13.text: And ʿAad and Pharaoh and the brothers

50:14.text: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubbaʿ. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled.

50:15.text: Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation.
